Definition: a Chaldaean or inhabitant of Chaldaea; by implication, a Magian or professional astrologer
BiblicalUsage: Chaldean = "clod breakers"; 1) the inhabitants of Chaldea, living on the lower Euphrates and Tigris; 2) those persons considered the wisest in the land (by extension)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
